title: EventEnvelope
description: Fixed envelope for every domain event. Event-specific files describe only the `payload`.

id.description: Event id; consumers use it for inbox deduplication.

occurredAt.description: UTC timestamp when the event occurred (not when it was published).

producer.description: Service that emitted the event, e.g. collection-service.

id.description: Principal id when known; null for SYSTEM.

correlationId.description: Ties together a business flow across services.

causationId.description: Id of the command or event that caused this event.

payload.description: Event-specific payload defined by the registry schema.
